purpose: Audit all four currently blocked operational OIS source lanes (USD/EUR/CHF/NZD), without treating indicative quotes or spot overnight indices as certified policy curves.

USD.preferred_source: CME/CBOT official 30-Day Federal Funds futures settlements (ZQ)
USD.known_problem: GitHub Actions probe 2026-10-19 accessed date-exact CME public website ZQ settlement tables for 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-15 (60 dated contracts each), but the T-5 session 2026-10-09 returned zero usable contracts. The official historical API requires OAuth, entitlement and a redistribution licence; public website viewing is not evidence of authorization for unattended ingestion/public redistribution.
USD.required_for_activation: Obtain the same contract settlement series with exact dates T, T-1, T-5, independently validate product ID, CME settlement method and permitted internal/redistribution use, then explicitly certify signal eligibility. Never infer T-5 from the public website if not available.
USD.prohibited_shortcut: Joining secondary single-contract quote dates or treating a forward monthly futures rate as spot OIS.

public_website_probe.note: Endpoint alone does not prove CME market-data entitlement or permit publishing quoted settlements. T-5 retrieval must be solved or sourced under authorized terms.

EUR.preferred_source: Eurex Three-Month Euro STR Futures, product FST3, daily exchange settlements
EUR.known_problem: Public FST3 secondary contract quotes have different observation dates. The official exchange EOD settlement service is not available through the requested private-user route; a business/institutional contractual entitlement and full T/T-1/T-5 synchronized series would need separate approval. €STR spot is not an OIS forward curve.
EUR.required_for_activation: Secure legal institutional/vendor access to official dated Eurex FST3 settlements and historical same-contract T/T-1/T-5 records, then separately validate licensing, compounding conventions, contract roll and 3M/6M/12M mapping. Otherwise WITHHELD.
EUR.prohibited_shortcut: Never join mixed-date TradingView FST3 quotes into one policy path, call futures OIS, or use ECB spot €STR as a future 3M/6M/12M OIS quote.
EUR.public_probe_policy: Public product contract specs establish instrument identity, not a certified curve or feed entitlement.

CHF.preferred_source: ICE Futures Europe Three-Month SARON futures (SA3) daily settlements
CHF.known_problem: ICE SA3 official daily contract settlement history T/T-1/T-5 not certified; ICE confirms exchange end-of-day report packages are sold via subscription. Eurex legacy FSO3 was delisted in 2021 and replaced with FSR3; a publicly visible FSR3 D. Settle column may show a single stale trading date and zero reported volume/open interest, not 3 coherent historical EOD snapshots.
CHF.required_for_activation: Secure verified, permitted-use, same-exchange, same-contract T/T-1/T-5 daily settlement series for ICE SA3 OR separately validated Eurex FSR3, then certify chronology, roll convention, 3M/6M/12M and source rights; never mix the two exchanges.
CHF.prohibited_shortcut: Combining ICE and Eurex quote conventions or dates; assuming price validity is timestamp.
CHF.public_probe_policy: Never infer active settlement history from FSR3 single-page D. Settle or stale Trading Date; zero volume/open interest is an additional liquidity warning, not a price certification.

NZD.meeting_date_source: NZFBF NZOR OIS RBNZ Meeting Date
NZD.known_problem: NZFBF NZOS/NZOR are actual OCR OIS benchmark closes distributed under NZFMA NZdata fee-liable licensing. No authorized machine-access entitlement is configured. ASX NZ bank-bill futures, RBNZ government bond yields and NZ OCR Compound Index cannot replace the prospective OIS 3M/6M/12M curve.
NZD.required_for_activation: Obtain documented NZdata NZOS/NZOR subscription and permitted internal/non-display/derived-publication rights, with same-date 3M/6M/12M closing observations, historical T/T-1/T-5 and authorized access. Otherwise WITHHELD, preserve ASX bank-bill proxy as direction only.
NZD.prohibited_shortcut: Promoting ASX 90-Day Bank Bill futures, RBNZ B2, or backward-looking OCR compound index to a prospective OIS curve.

source_registry_note: Updated source entitlement information on 2026-10-23. Neither private-service eligibility nor a vendor licence is in place for EUR/NZD official OIS. Secondary Eurex FST3 individual dated quotes and ASX bank-bill futures provide separate, explicitly non-OIS research context. Official OIS_DATA remains WITHHELD until approved from licensed same-basis dated records. Do not place private email correspondence or contact details in the public source plan.
